scope: standard weak-field PPN counting through O(v^3) for slowly moving matter, on the identical frozen U1+RTK action

ppn_ordering.one_time_derivative: raises PN order by one relative to one spatial derivative
ppn_ordering.K_ij: O(3), hence quadratic K terms begin at O(6)
ppn_ordering.bare_lapse: N=1+n2+O(4); the O(2) Hamiltonian/A scalar subsystem is unchanged by O(3) shift terms and requires n2=0 under the same regular asymptotic boundary condition

scalar_background.homogeneous_scalar_perturbation: set to zero by the standard no-extra-homogeneous-mode / no-incoming-scalar PPN boundary condition

target_statements: the moving-matter O(2) scalar constraint still gives n2=0 because shift/time-derivative gravitational terms enter beyond O(2)
at D_i Sigma=0 the invariant shift B^i=N^i-N D^i nu drops out of Theta_U exactly on the background, so the scalar action has no direct O(3) shift/vector source
P=P_X=0 through O(3) and D_iTheta_U=0 through O(3), so first variations of both P(X_U) and C(X_U)(DTheta_U)^2 with respect to N^i, nu, g_ij and Sigma carry no O(3) source on the chosen PPN branch
therefore the full O(3) vector/shift equations coincide with the corresponding pure-U1 family-I equations through O(3), subject to the stated no-homogeneous-scalar boundary condition
non_claims: does not prove absence of freely specified RTK scalar waves; the PPN branch excludes an independent incoming/homogeneous scalar excitation
does not cover strong-field rotation, compact objects, DBI-boundary configurations or X_U->0
does not yet set alpha1 or alpha2 until the separate preferred-frame inheritance gate checks the U1 formulas and limiting cancellations
does not establish radiative stability, UV completion, strong-coupling scale or EFT cutoff
next_gate_if_pass: evaluate/factor the sigma1=sigma2=0 U1 alpha1,alpha2 expressions at a1=kappa=1,a2=0 before taking gamma1=-1 and lambda_HL=1 limits, and certify preferred-frame values only if the cancellations are regular
